events.summary: Baseline review of the project-maintained Openverse audio provider example: registry metadata, package bytes, provider manifest, declared network access, source/licence provenance, source policy and deterministic fixture tests were checked for the published 0.1.0 example.
limitations: Openverse licence information is index metadata and should be verified at the original source before reuse.
Project-maintained example review; this does not cryptographically verify a publisher identity or provide a legal/content endorsement.
